claim_text: Potassium supplements can cause hyperkalemia in people with impaired renal potassium excretion; kidney disease and medicines affecting potassium balance require review before supplementation.
health_goal_or_outcome: Prevent avoidable harm from inappropriate supplementation.

population.other_context: People with kidney disease considering potassium supplements.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Supplement products; verify exact formulation and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Potassium fact sheet describes potassium homeostasis, hyperkalemia and renal/medicine-related risk.
limitations: Exact source passages and clinical applicability require full appraisal.
